message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. However, I can give you a quick overview of San Francisco’s typical climate:

| Season | Typical High | Typical Low | Notes |
|--------|--------------|-------------|-------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | ~7 °C (45 °F) | Mild, often cloudy, occasional fog |
| Spring (Mar–May) | ~15 °C (59 °F) | ~9 °C (48 °F) | Gradually warming, still some fog |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | ~20 °C (68 °F) | ~13 °C (55 °F) | Cool, breezy, “June Gloom” early summer |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | ~18 °C (64 °F) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | Pleasant, less fog, cooler evenings |

If you need a current forecast, you could check a reliable weather website or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of what to expect today based on typical patterns!
